title: Self-adjointness of the sign affine operator
statement: For any real number $\rho$ and functions $f,g:\{-1,1\}\to\mathbb{R}$, the uniform inner product of the affine transform of $f$ with $g$ equals the uniform inner product of $f$ with the affine transform of $g$. Here the transform sends $f(x)$ to $\frac{f(1)+f(-1)}2+\rho\frac{f(1)-f(-1)}2x$.
